title: Hickory-DNS 0.26.0-beta.1 before 0.26.2 DNSSEC Nonexistence Proof Forgery via NSEC3
description: CVE-2026-123580 is a vulnerability in Hickory-DNS versions before 0.26.2 that allows DNSSEC nonexistence proof forgery via NSEC3. This flaw affects version 4.0 of the Microsoft product referenced. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided. No patch or remediation details are available in the provided data.
